18-07-2026

                                      NOTICE
       It is hereby informed to all concerned that the First Phase Admission to the
Integrated Teacher Education Programme (ITEP) in the Arts, Science, and Commerce
streams is scheduled to be held on 20th and 21st July, 2026. The First Phase Provisional
Merit List has already been published on the college website. All selected candidates are
requested to accept the admission offer through the SAMARTH Portal using their User
ID and Password.
       The selected candidates are further instructed to complete the admission process
either online or offline (physical mode) at the Dudhnoi College campus on the above-
mentioned dates.
       Candidates opting for the online mode of admission must pay the prescribed
admission fee through the SBI Collect module under "Dudhnoi College ITEP (ITEP
Admission Fee)". After making the payment, they must send the following documents to
dudhnoicollege@gmail.com on or before 4:00 PM on 21st July, 2026:

   1. SBI Collect payment receipt.
   2. Copy of the SAMARTH Portal application form.

       Submission of these documents via email is mandatory to complete the online
admission process.
       Further, all candidates who complete the admission process through either online
mode or offline mode must submit the following documents at the Dudhnoi College
Office at the time of admission or on or before 3rd August, 2026.

   1.   Samarth Application Form
   2.   Mark sheet & admit Card ( NCET Exam)
   3.   Original & Xerox copy of Mark sheet and Certificate (HSLC & HS)
   4.   Original & Xerox Copy of Admit Card and Registration Card (HSLC & HS)
   5.   Caste Certificate (if applicable)
   6.   Aadhar Card & Bank Passbook
   7.   APAAR ID

* Admission Fees: Admission fees will be Rs. 25000/-
